subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone consolidated revenue, management forecast basis
locator: Act I, headline seller case table
author: Seller/Management
statement: The seller presents FY2025 revenue of $74.0 million as a management forecast.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone seller-adjusted EBITDA including $2.5m of seller adjustments
locator: Act I, headline seller case table
author: Seller/Management
statement: The seller presents adjusted EBITDA of $12.7 million, including $2.5 million of seller adjustments.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone seller-defined EBITDA basis
locator: Act I, headline seller case table
author: Seller/Management
statement: The seller presents an EBITDA margin of 17.2% based on seller-defined EBITDA.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Largest customer measured at billing-account level, not ultimate parent
locator: Act I, headline seller case table
author: Seller/Management
statement: The seller presents the largest customer as 7.6% of revenue, measured by billing account rather than ultimate parent.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Riverton Industrial Group aggregated across seven billing accounts and six facilities on ultimate-parent basis
author: Buyer/PANTA
statement: Buyer found Riverton Industrial Group actually represents 18.2% of revenue on a parent basis versus the seller-advertised 7.6% billing-account figure.
derivation: Aggregated seven billing accounts across six facilities belonging to Riverton Industrial Group as percentage of total revenue, per customer schedule in data room.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone scheduled or repeat activity, including repeat projects as well as scheduled programs
locator: Act I, headline seller case table
author: Seller/Management
statement: The seller claims 72% of activity is recurring or repeat, including both scheduled programs and repeat projects.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone platform across four acquired companies
locator: Act I, headline seller case table
author: Seller/Management
statement: The seller describes Alderstone as commercially integrated despite systems and processes remaining partially different across acquisitions.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone total active billing accounts
author: Seller/Management
statement: The seller states Alderstone has more than 600 active billing accounts.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone acquisitions completed since 2020
author: Seller/Management
statement: The seller states Alderstone has completed four acquisitions since 2020.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone reported/historical accounting EBITDA, unadjusted
locator: Act II, five EBITDA figures table
author: Buyer/PANTA
statement: Reported EBITDA per historical accounting records is $10.2 million, versus seller-adjusted EBITDA of $12.7 million.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone QoE-normalized EBITDA, independent historical earnings view
locator: Act II, five EBITDA figures table
author: QoE Firm
statement: The QoE firm certifies normalized EBITDA of $11.9 million as an independent historical earnings view.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone firm-underwritten EBITDA used for valuation and leverage basis
locator: Act II, five EBITDA figures table
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The Firm underwrites EBITDA at $11.4 million, applying further reserves for revenue quality, customer risk, integration cost and finance capability beyond the QoE figure.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone covenant EBITDA at entry, lender-defined contractual credit calculation
locator: Act II, five EBITDA figures table
author: Lender
statement: Covenant EBITDA at entry is contractually defined at $12.2 million, distinct from firm-underwritten and QoE EBITDA figures.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone pricing and utilization initiative add-backs, not yet achieved
author: QoE Firm
statement: The QoE firm declines to accept $0.5 million of seller-included pricing and utilization initiatives as historical earnings since they have not yet been achieved.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Riverton Industrial Group relationship terms
author: Buyer/PANTA
statement: There are no minimum-volume guarantees with Riverton, and the relationship can be reduced or terminated with ordinary notice, though it spans years, facilities and service lines.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone base case treatment of Riverton concentration risk
locator: Act II, Canonical Case Position callout
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The Firm's canonical position treats Riverton as a major concentration risk but keeps it in the base case while modelling a material reduction in the downside case, given tenure, multiple facilities and service lines.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone four acquired businesses' billing, project code, customer master, time-entry, WIP and AR systems
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The buyer finds that despite the seller calling the platform integrated due to shared branding and commercial coordination, billing systems, project codes, customer masters, time-entry systems, WIP controls and AR processes remain fragmented across four acquisitions.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone systems migration causal risk pathway
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The Firm identifies that a failed systems migration could delay invoices, increase WIP and DSO, divert managers, lower utilization, damage service, lose customers, weaken EBITDA and increase leverage, a causal path that later occurs.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone seller-proposed normalized working capital target
author: Seller/Management
statement: The seller proposes a normalized working-capital target of $7.7 million.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone QoE-normalized working capital target including aged unbilled WIP, billing delays, payroll accruals, deferred-revenue normalization and month-end timing
author: QoE Firm
statement: The QoE firm concludes an $8.4 million normalized working-capital target is appropriate versus the seller's proposed $7.7 million.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Difference between QoE and seller-proposed normalized working capital targets
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The $0.7 million gap between the seller's $7.7 million and the QoE's $8.4 million working-capital target affects closing economics immediately.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone overall earnings quality versus seller presentation
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The buyer concludes that Alderstone's earnings are lower-quality than advertised by the seller.
derivation: Supported by: EBITDA (reported $10.2m vs seller-adjusted $12.7m vs QoE $11.9m vs firm-underwritten $11.4m), Customer Concentration 18.2%, Systems Integration Risk

perimeter: Alderstone entry EV/EBITDA multiple on firm-underwritten basis
author: Dissenting IC member
statement: The dissenting IC member notes the entry multiple is 9.5x, insufficient in his view to compensate for an 18.2% customer concentration and incomplete integration.

author: PANTA/Firm

subject: Alderstone

author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The standalone base case underwrites a 14.8% IRR.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone standalone downside case, lower growth, margin and cash conversion
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The standalone downside case models 1.28x MOIC under lower growth, margin and cash conversion assumptions.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone standalone downside case
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The standalone downside case models a 5.1% IRR.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone standalone upside case, stronger operations and cash generation
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The standalone upside case models 2.43x MOIC with stronger operations and cash generation.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone standalone upside case
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The standalone upside case models a 19.5% IRR.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone acquisition base case including Sentinel and a second funded add-on
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The acquisition base case underwrites 2.08x MOIC including Sentinel plus a second funded add-on.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone acquisition base case
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: The acquisition base case underwrites a 16.0% IRR.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone acquisition approval conditions
author: Investment Committee
statement: The IC approves the transaction subject to thirteen explicit conditions including EBITDA basis, NWC target, integration plan, liquidity reserve and reporting requirements.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone acquisition IC vote outcome
author: Investment Committee
statement: The IC approves the transaction 4-1, with one member dissenting on the basis that concentration, integration and multiple risks were not sufficiently compensated.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone IC decision epistemic vs decision state
author: Investment Committee
statement: The IC accepts customer concentration and integration risk as real and unresolved while nevertheless approving the deal under conditions, reflecting a contested-but-accepted institutional position.

subject: Alderstone
perimeter: Alderstone acquisition of Sentinel post-close
author: PANTA/Firm
statement: After closing, Alderstone acquires Sentinel, adding revenue and EBITDA but also more customer records, systems and project codes to an already difficult integration program.

subject: Alderstone
